<h1 id="опасные-расширения-gfm" data-source-start="1" data-source-end="1">Опасные расширения GFM</h1>
<p data-source-start="4" data-source-end="4">Инлайн-математика пробует выйти наружу: <span class="math math-inline">&lt;/span&gt;&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;&lt;span&gt;</span></p>
<p data-source-start="6" data-source-end="6">Блочная математика:</p>
<div class="math math-display" data-source-start="8" data-source-end="10">&lt;/div&gt;&lt;script&gt;alert(2)&lt;/script&gt;&lt;div&gt;
</div>
<p data-source-start="12" data-source-end="12">Фенс математики:</p>
<div class="math math-display" data-source-start="14" data-source-end="16">&lt;/div&gt;&lt;img src=x onerror=&#34;alert(3)&#34;&gt;
</div>
<p data-source-start="18" data-source-end="18">Mermaid со скриптом:</p>
<pre class="mermaid" data-source-start="20" data-source-end="22">graph TD; A[&lt;script&gt;alert(4)&lt;/script&gt;] --&gt; B[&#34;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;iframe src=//evil.example&gt;&#34;];
</pre>
<p data-source-start="24" data-source-end="24">Маркер alert-а с попыткой подмешать класс:</p>
<blockquote data-source-start="26" data-source-end="27">
<p data-source-start="26" data-source-end="27">[!NOTE&#34; onclick=&#34;alert(5)]
тело</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote data-source-start="29" data-source-end="30">
<p data-source-start="29" data-source-end="30">[!NOTE zzz]
тело</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-source-start="32" data-source-end="32">Подделка alert-а руками:</p>
<div class="alert alert-note">
<p class="alert-title">Note</p>
</div>
